description_en: Retrieves the details of a Tair (Redis-compatible) instance
description_zh: 查询云数据库 Tair（兼容 Redis）实例的详细信息
name: DescribeInstanceAttribute

ArchitectureType.description_en:
The architecture of the instance. Valid values:

cluster: The instance is a cluster instance.

standard: The instance is a standard instance.

rwsplit: The instance is a read/write splitting instance
ArchitectureType.description_zh:
实例的架构，返回值：
cluster：集群版。
standard：标准版。
rwsplit：读写分离版

AuditLogRetention.description_en: The retention period of the audit log. Unit: days. A value of 0 indicates that the audit log feature is disabled. For more information about how to enable the audit log feature, see [Enable audit logging]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/102015.html）
AuditLogRetention.description_zh: 审计日志中设置的日志保留时间，单位为天。0代表未开通审计日志，开通方式请参见[开通审计日志]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/102015.html）

AutoSecondaryZone.description_en:
Indicates whether the secondary zone is automatically selected. Valid values:

true: The secondary zone is automatically selected.

false: The secondary zone is not automatically selected
AutoSecondaryZone.description_zh:
自动分配 Secondary 可用区。
true：自动分配
false：非自动分配

AvailabilityValue.description_en: The availability metric of the instance in the current month

BackupLogStartTime.description_en:
The earliest point in time to which data can be restored. The time is in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format and is displayed in UTC.

This parameter is returned only if the [Data Flashback]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/148479.html） feature is enabled for the instance.

When you call the [RestoreInstance]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/473824.html） operation to perform a data flashback, this is the earliest value that can be specified for the RestoreTime parameter
BackupLogStartTime.description_zh: 允许闪回的最早时间点，格式为yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ（UTC时间）。 当Redis实例开启了[数据闪回]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/148479.html）功能，才会返回本参数。 调用[RestoreInstance]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/473824.html）接口执行数据闪回时，可通过本参数的返回值确认允许闪回的最早时间点（即**RestoreTime**可传入的最早时间点）

Bandwidth.description_en: The bandwidth of the instance. Unit: Mbit/s

Capacity.description_en: The memory capacity of the instance. Unit: MB

ChargeType.description_en:
The billing method of the instance. Valid values:

PrePaid: subscription

PostPaid: pay-as-you-go
ChargeType.description_zh:
付费类型，返回值：
PrePaid：预付费，即包年包月。
PostPaid：后付费，即按量付费

CloudType.description_en: This parameter is returned only for ApsaraDB for Redis instances that are created in Alibaba Cloud clouds
CloudType.description_zh: 仅云盒实例显示该参数

Config.description_en:
The parameter settings of the instance. The settings are in the JSON format. For more information, see [Parameters]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/43885.html）.
To view the audit log configuration, call the [DescribeAuditLogConfig]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/473830.html） operation
Config.description_zh:
实例的参数配置信息，格式为JSON，详情请参见[参数说明]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/43885.html），
查看审计日志配置可使用[DescribeAuditLogConfig]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/473830.html）接口

ConnectionDomain.description_en: The internal endpoint of the instance

CreateTime.description_en: The time when the instance was created. The time follows the ISO 8601 standard in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format. The time is displayed in UTC

EndTime.description_en: The expiration time of the subscription instance. The time is in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format and is displayed in UTC
EndTime.description_zh: 预付费实例到期时间，格式为yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ（UTC时间）

Engine.description_en: The database engine. The value is fixed as Redis
Engine.description_zh: 数据库类型，返回值固定为Redis

EngineVersion.description_en: The database engine version of the instance. Valid values: 2.8, 4.0, 5.0, 6.0, and 7.0
EngineVersion.description_zh: 实例兼容Redis的版本，返回值：2.8、4.0、5.0、6.0或7.0

GlobalInstanceId.description_en:
The ID of the distributed instance.

This parameter is returned only for child instances of a distributed instance
GlobalInstanceId.description_zh:
所属的分布式实例ID。
当Redis实例为分布式实例中的子实例时，才会返回本参数

HasRenewChangeOrder.description_en:
Indicates whether a pending order for renewal or configuration change exists for the instance. Valid values:

true

false
HasRenewChangeOrder.description_zh:
是否有未生效的续费变配订单，返回值：
true：是。
false：否

InstanceClass.description_en: The instance type. For more information, see [Instance types]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/107984.html）
InstanceClass.description_zh: 实例规格，请参见[实例规格表]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/107984.html）

InstanceReleaseProtection.description_en:
Indicates whether release protection is enabled for the instance. Valid values:

true: Release protection is enabled.

false: Release protection is disabled
InstanceReleaseProtection.description_zh:
是否开启了实例释放保护，返回值：
true：已开启。
false：未开启

InstanceStatus.description_en:
The state of the instance. Valid values:

Normal: The instance is running as expected.

Creating: The instance is being created.

Changing: The instance configuration is being changed.

Inactive: The instance is disabled.

Flushing: The instance is being released.

Released: The instance is released.

Transforming: The billing method of the instance is being changed.

Migrating: The instance is being migrated.

BackupRecovering: The instance is being restored from a backup.

MinorVersionUpgrading: The minor version of the instance is being updated.

NetworkModifying: The network type of the instance is being changed.

SSLModifying: The SSL certificate of the instance is being changed.

MajorVersionUpgrading: The major version of the instance is being upgraded. The instance remains accessible during the upgrade.

For more information about instance states and their impacts, see [Instance states]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/200740.html）
InstanceStatus.description_zh:
实例状态，返回值：
Normal：正常。
Creating：创建中。
Changing：修改中。
Inactive：被禁用。
Flushing：清除中。
Released：已释放。
Transforming：转换中。
Migrating：迁移中。
BackupRecovering：备份恢复中。
MinorVersionUpgrading：小版本升级中。
NetworkModifying：网络变更中。
SSLModifying：SSL变更中。
MajorVersionUpgrading：大版本升级中，可正常访问。

更多实例状态及详细信息，请参见[实例状态与影响]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/200740.html）

InstanceType.description_en:
The database engine. Valid values:

Tair

Redis: ApsaraDB for Redis Community Edition instances and classic ApsaraDB for Redis Enhanced Edition (Tair) memory-type instances are of the Redis database engine.

Memcache
InstanceType.description_zh:
实例类型，返回值： Tair Redis
其中经典版Tair内存型也会返回Redis实例类型。 Memcache

IsOrderCompleted.description_en:
Indicates whether a configuration change is complete. Valid values:

true: The configuration change is complete, or no configuration change is in progress.

false: The configuration change is in progress
IsOrderCompleted.description_zh:
实例订单是否完成，用于判断变配订单是否到达终态，返回值：
true：变配已完成，或进行未变配。
false：变配中

IsRds.description_en:
Indicates whether the instance is managed by RDS. Valid values:

true: The instance is managed by RDS.

false: The instance is not managed by RDS
IsRds.description_zh:
是否属RDS管控，返回值：
true：是。
false：否

IsSupportTDE.description_en:
Indicates whether Transparent Data Encryption (TDE) is supported. Valid values:

true: TDE is supported. This feature is supported only for ApsaraDB for Redis Enhanced Edition (Tair) memory-type instances.

false: TDE is not supported
IsSupportTDE.description_zh:
实例是否支持开启透明数据加密TDE（Transparent Data Encryption）功能，返回值：
true：支持，仅经典版内存型实例支持。
false：不支持

MaintainEndTime.description_en: The end time of the maintenance window. The time is in the HH:mmZ format and is displayed in UTC
MaintainEndTime.description_zh: 可运维结束时间，格式为HH:mmZ（UTC时间）

MaintainStartTime.description_en: The start time of the maintenance window. The time is in the HH:mmZ format and is displayed in UTC
MaintainStartTime.description_zh: 可运维开始时间，格式为HH:mmZ（UTC时间）

NetworkType.description_en:
The network type of the instance. Valid values:

CLASSIC: classic network

VPC: VPC
NetworkType.description_zh:
网络类型，返回值：
CLASSIC：经典网络。
VPC：专有网络

NodeType.description_en:
The node type. Valid values:

double: The instance has two data nodes.

single: The instance has a single data node.

readone: The read/write splitting instance has one read-only node.

readthree: The read/write splitting instance has three read-only nodes
NodeType.description_zh:
节点类型，返回值：
double：双副本。
single：单副本。
readone：经典架构读写分离实例，一个只读节点。
readthree：经典架构读写分离实例，三个只读节点

PackageType.description_en:
The edition of the instance. Valid values:

standard: standard edition

customized: The customized edition is discontinued
PackageType.description_zh:
套餐类型，返回值：
standard：标准套餐。
customized：定制套餐，已下线

Port.description_en: The service port of the instance

PrivateIp.description_en:
The private IP address of the instance.

This parameter is not returned if the network type of the instance is classic network
PrivateIp.description_zh:
专有网络IP地址。
实例的网络类型为经典网络时，不会返回本参数

ReadOnlyCount.description_en:
The number of read-only nodes in the primary zone.

The ReadOnlyCount and SlaveReadOnlyCount parameters are returned only for cloud-native instances for which read/write splitting is enabled. If the instance uses the cluster architecture, these parameters specify the number of read-only nodes per shard in the primary and secondary zones
ReadOnlyCount.description_zh:
主可用区的只读节点数（个）。
ReadOnlyCount与SlaveReadOnlyCount参数仅适用于云原生版、开启读写分离的实例。如果实例为集群架构，则上述参数分别表示单分片的（主、备可用区）只读节点数量

RealInstanceClass.description_en:
If the instance is a cloud-native cluster instance, this parameter indicates the actual instance type of the shards. In this case, the InstanceClass parameter indicates a virtual instance type.

To query the fees for an instance of this instance type, specify the value of this parameter in the [DescribePrice]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/473807.html） operation
RealInstanceClass.description_zh:
当实例为云原生版集群实例时，本参数为云原生版集群实例的实际分片规格，InstanceClass参数为虚拟规格。
如需查询该规格的实例费用，可在[DescribePrice]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/473807.html）接口中指定本参数返回的实例规格进行查询

ReplicaCount.description_en:
The number of replica nodes in the primary zone.

The ReplicaCount and SlaveReplicaCount parameters are returned only for cloud-native instances. If the instance uses the cluster architecture, these parameters specify the number of replica nodes per shard in the primary and secondary zones
ReplicaCount.description_zh:
主可用区的备节点数（个）。
ReplicaCount与SlaveReplicaCount参数仅适用于云原生版实例。如果实例为集群架构，则上述参数分别表示单分片的（主、备可用区）备节点数

ReplicaId.description_en: The ID of the replica node

ReplicationMode.description_en:
The replication architecture. Valid values:

master-slave: master-replica architecture

cluster: cluster architecture, which includes read/write splitting and cluster instances

db: cloud-native sharded cluster architecture
ReplicationMode.description_zh:
副本架构，返回值：
master-slave：标准版的主备架构。
cluster：集群架构，包含读写分离版或集群版。
db：云原生分片集群架构

ResourceGroupId.description_en: The ID of the resource group to which the instance belongs

SecondaryZoneId.description_en:
The ID of the secondary zone.

If the instance is not deployed in a secondary zone, this parameter is not returned
SecondaryZoneId.description_zh:
备可用区ID。
实例没有备可用区ID时，不返回本参数

ShardCount.description_en:
The number of shards.

<props="china">

This parameter is returned only if the instance is a cloud-native instance that uses the cluster architecture and is available on the China site (aliyun.com).

</props>
ShardCount.description_zh:
分片数，本参数仅适用于中国站。

<props="china">当实例为[集群架构]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/52228.html）的云原生版实例时，才会返回本参数。</props>

SlaveReadOnlyCount.description_en: The number of read-only nodes in the secondary zone. This parameter is returned only when read/write splitting is enabled for an instance that is deployed in multiple zones
SlaveReadOnlyCount.description_zh: 备可用区的只读节点数，该参数仅在多可用区中开启读写分离后才会返回

SlaveReplicaCount.description_en: The number of replica nodes in the secondary zone
SlaveReplicaCount.description_zh: 备可用区的备节点数（个）

Storage.description_en: The storage space of an ApsaraDB for Redis Enhanced Edition (Tair) instance that uses enhanced SSDs (ESSDs)
Storage.description_zh: Tair ESSD磁盘型的存储空间

VpcAuthMode.description_en:
The authentication mode for the instance that is deployed in a VPC. Valid values:

Open: Password authentication is enabled.

Close: Password-free access is enabled
VpcAuthMode.description_zh:
VPC认证模式，返回值：
Open：需要密码认证。
Close：关闭密码认证，即开启了[VPC免密功能]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/85168.html）

VpcCloudInstanceId.description_en: The ID of the instance that is deployed in a VPC

VpcId.description_en: The ID of the virtual private cloud (VPC)

ZoneType.description_en:
The zone type of the instance. Valid values:

singlezone: single-zone

doublezone: multi-zone
ZoneType.description_zh:
可用区类型，返回值：
singlezone：同城单可用区。
doublezone：同城双可用区
